p: left similar land of intermediate quality
I have left you a place from which to collect;
where Reuven sold a field to Shimon with a guarantee
and Reuven’s creditor comes and repossesses
the law is that Reuven goes and rescues
cannot say to … I am not legally answerable to you … because … can retort: … What you take from him comes back to me:
cannot say to Reuven: I am not legally answerable to you since I am taking the field from Shimon. This is because Reuven can retort: What you take from him comes back to me:

w.32: I am not legally answerable … you … because … can retort … What you take from … comes back … me
